summary: Senales (Schnals, population 1,229) is a South Tyrolean valley municipality whose parking is dominated by the glacier ski area at Kurzras at the valley head, reached by an asphalted all-year road and a regular bus line 261 from Naturns. Parking at Kurzras was brought under managed charging through conventions between the Gemeinderat and the Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG (decisions in May 2023 and November 2024). Today the outdoor car park by the valley station is barrier-free with number-plate recognition, run by Mobility Hub Parkservice Italia, with 60 minutes free, 6 euro a day and nothing to pay after 17:00, while the new indoor car park (about 40 spaces, opened with the rebuilt valley station in 2024/25) charges per hour. The municipality has also built a car park and toilets at Vernagt, decided on paid parking zones there on 29 April 2026 and signed EasyPark and Pagobancomat payment agreements in May 2026, and is studying more parking at Karthaus. A 40- or 80-pitch motorhome site stands at Kurzras. No information on EV charging was found. Most municipal evidence consists of register titles only, since the resolution texts are not published online.

items.text: On 15 May 2023 the Gemeinderat of Schnals took a basic decision (no. 23) on managed car-park charging in Kurzras and approved a convention with the Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG that delimits the areas (no. 24). Only the register titles were readable; the documents themselves are not attached online.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: On 13 November 2024 the Gemeinderat again decided on managed car-park charging in Kurzras (basic decision no. 39) and approved a new convention with the Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG delimiting the areas (no. 40). Only the register titles were readable, so the content of the convention is unknown.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: The Gletscherbahnen page, read on 21 October 2026, lists the outdoor car park about 100 m from the valley station in Kurzras as barrier-free with number-plate recognition: 60 minutes free from 00:00 to 17:00, then 6 euro for the day ticket and 12 euro for each further day, no payment from 17:00 to 24:00. Unpaid stays are charged 80 euro per day.
items.source_title: Anreise und Parken in der Alpin Arena Schnals (Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG)

items.text: According to the same page (read 21 October 2026) the Kurzras outdoor car park is run by Mobility Hub Parkservice Italia S.R.L.; payment is by machine (coins, card, Apple/Google Pay), by QR code or website within 24 hours after leaving, or via EasyPark.
items.source_title: Anreise und Parken in der Alpin Arena Schnals (Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG)

items.text: The page read on 21 October 2026 gives the indoor car park at the Kurzras valley station as about 40 spaces at 1.50 euro per hour with a daily maximum of 18 euro, payable at the exit by contactless card or at a 24-hour card machine. Four disabled bays are signed, two paid in the garage and one (page text) free outside.
items.source_title: Anreise und Parken in der Alpin Arena Schnals (Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG)

items.text: In a news item dated 28 March 2025 the Gletscherbahnen quoted the new indoor car park at the Kurzras valley station as about 40 spaces at 2.50 euro per hour with a daily maximum of 24 euro. This differs from the 1.50 and 18 euro shown on the current page (undated), so the tariff has apparently been lowered since.
items.source_title: Vieles NEU in der Alpin Arena Schnals (Alpin Arena Schnals, news 28.03.2025)

items.text: The construction diary of the Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen reports that the new valley station in Kurzras was completed on 23 December 2024; the second building phase had started in April 2024 and included a 44-space underground garage, a restaurant and a covered access to the cable car. The new reversible cable car (about 2,150 m long, 1,180 m of height gain, under 6 minutes) opened at Christmas 2023.
On 29 April 2026 the Gemeinderat of Schnals decided on the introduction of paid parking zones in Vernagt (resolution no. 19); only the register title was readable, so tariffs and zones are not known.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: On 6 May 2026 the Gemeindeausschuss approved agreements with EasyPark Italia (resolutions no. 232) and with Nexi Payments for the 'Pagobancomat' service (no. 233) for paying the municipality's parking fees. This fits the start of the paid zones in Vernagt, but the titles do not name the location.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: On 13 May 2026 the Gemeindeausschuss approved the conditions for using parts of plots 262/2, 263/1 and 1212/1 in Unser Frau as a temporary car park at Vernagt for 2026 (resolution no. 236). In 2024 and 2025 the municipality had already contracted a temporary car park at Vernagt and compensated the landowner.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: The municipality closed out a project to design the car park at Vernagt with a connecting pavement (final works approved April 2025, bond released 25 June 2025) and had public toilets built there in 2024. A road-marking and signage contract for the Vernagt car park followed on 29 October 2025.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: The Gemeindeausschuss commissioned a technical-economic variant study on improving the parking situation in Karthaus (the municipal seat) on 30 October 2024 and a feasibility study for a car park there on 27 December 2024. No resolution to build was found.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: On 20 December 2023 the Gemeinderat set the contribution due in lieu of providing parking spaces for new buildings and extensions under Article 7 of provincial decree no. 17 of 7 May 2020; the amount is not visible in the register title.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: Public transport in the valley is supported locally: on 18 June 2025 the Gemeindeausschuss granted a contribution to the Tourismusgenossenschaft Schnalstal for running the ski bus service (the title refers to the 2023/24 season), and in November 2024 it contracted two new bus-stop bases in Kurzras. In April 2026 it commissioned design work to move the bus stops on the provincial road LS3 in Vernagt.
items.source_title: Gemeinde Schnals - Beschlüsse und Maßnahmen (Register der Beschlüsse)

items.text: The Gletscherbahnen state that the road to Kurzras is asphalted and open all year, and that line 261 runs hourly to Kurzras. The caravan park site adds that the valley bus runs hourly in daytime and that the SkibusCard gives free rides inside the valley from October to early May.
items.source_title: Anreise und Parken in der Alpin Arena Schnals (Schnalstaler Gletscherbahnen AG)

items.text: A provincial Südtirolmobil notice dated 12 May 2022 reported more services on line 261 Naturns - Schnalstal (hourly, also Sundays) and that direct services to Meran were suspended, with passengers changing to line 251 or the train in Naturns. The ski-area page now speaks of a line running from Meran, so the current routing should be checked.
items.source_title: More bus connections in the peripheries (Südtirolmobil news, 12.05.2022)

items.text: The Caravan Park Schnals at Kurzras is a barrier-controlled motorhome site open 24 hours with online booking. Its site (read 21 October 2026) gives 40 pitches on the home page and 80 pitches on the 'Wissenswertes' page, and daily prices per vehicle of 36 to 46 euro between June 2026 and May 2027, power included.
items.source_title: Caravan Park Schnals - Preise und Wissenswertes

items.text: The municipality of Schnals had 1,229 inhabitants at 31 December 2025, so day and winter-sport visitors to the Kurzras glacier ski area, not residents, drive parking demand in the valley.

gaps: EV charging in Kurzras, Vernagt, Karthaus or Unser Frau: nothing found on the Gletscherbahnen, caravan park or municipal pages, and the web searches returned no relevant source.

Texts of the Gemeinderat resolutions no. 23/24 (15.05.2023), 39/40 (13.11.2024) and no. 19 (29.04.2026) are not attached in the register at https://www.gemeinde.schnals.bz.it/de/Beschluesse_und_Massnahmen; Vernagt tariffs, zones and start date are unknown.

The feed names 'Parcheggio P4 Senales' (42 spaces) and 'Parcheggio Caravanpark Senales' (120 spaces); no source identified a P4 car park, and the operator's own pages give 40 and 80 pitches for the caravan park, so the capacities cannot be matched.

The date of the indoor-car-park tariff change from 2.50 euro (max 24) to 1.50 euro (max 18) per hour is not given; the Anreise page is undated. Third-party listings quote a 120-minute free period for the outdoor car park, which differs from the 60 minutes on the official page.

Current routing of bus line 261 (Meran direct vs change in Naturns) and the 2026/27 timetable could not be confirmed from a current official page; the Südtirolmobil news read is from 2022. The Meran tourism ski-bus page redirected to the homepage and was not used.

No Italian-language or press (Dolomiten, Vinschgerwind, Tageszeitung) coverage of Schnals parking decisions was found; the stol.it bus-timetable articles returned no readable text. No provincial (Land Südtirol) parking decision specific to Schnals was found.

Sources not used because only listings or unreadable: suedtirol.live, roterhahn.it, vinschgau.net parking listings (undated, contradictory on summer/winter charging); the Merano tourism ski-bus page (redirect).
